facts.value: Allocates an HSD_GObj and initializes its classifier, process-link/priority and attachment fields. For placement modes 0 through 3 it inserts the new object using priority or relative position. Allocation failure returns NULL. Other mode values return the allocated object without performing insertion.
facts.rationale: The switch has no default and therefore does not guarantee a linked result for every successful allocation.

facts.value: Mode 0 inserts after equal-priority entries; mode 1 inserts before them. Mode 2 inserts after position, with NULL meaning the bucket head. Mode 3 inserts before position and dereferences position without a null check. Unknown modes perform no insertion after allocation. The p_link bound is asserted, and NULL allocation returns NULL before field writes.
facts.rationale: Records nullable mode-2 position and the unchecked mode domain instead of implying all successful allocations are linked.

facts.value: On deferral, saves placement mode, p_link, priority and position into the pending-operation record and sets b3. Otherwise unlinks each process from scheduling, reverses its child chain temporarily, clears gobj->proc, repairs the old GObj bucket, changes p_link/priority, and uses modes 0-3 to insert. It reinserts the saved processes through HSD_GObjProc_8038FAA8, which prepends each child and restores original child order.
facts.rationale: The active GObj pointer is implicit in scheduler context rather than copied into the deferred record; unknown modes skip GObj insertion.

facts.value: When the target is the active GObj and b0 is clear, stores a deferred relocation and returns. Otherwise mode 0 places after equal priorities, mode 1 before equal priorities, mode 2 after position or at head for NULL, and mode 3 before a required position. Other values skip insertion. facts.rationale: Records exact mode edge cases and modulo-three stamp adjustment without implying unchecked modes are safe.
